# Product risks

Risk-based testing (ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-2): what could go wrong in the product, how bad it would be, and which
tests reduce it. Level = Likelihood × Impact.

| ID               | Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Level | Mitigated by    | Status |
| ---------------- | ---- | ---------- | ------ | ----- | --------------- | ------ |
| RSK-<FEATURE>-01 |      | Medium     | High   | High  | AC-<FEATURE>-01 | open   |

`Likelihood`, `Impact`, `Level`: High, Medium, Low. `Status`: open, mitigated, accepted, closed.
